title: mimid-chat: a JMAP mode against a mimid server (Room/create, KeyPackage/set, KeyMaterial/fetch)
description: Client-side steps from mimid-1wgh.12.4's design draft (steps 5-7), split off when the server side of Room/create landed 2026-11-15: mimid-seed --issue-token; mimid-chat --mimid mode that publishes KeyPackages with KeyPackage/set, builds the group (external sender = hubSender, franking_agent, Safe AAD requiring frank_aad, roles_list, base_room_policy, participant_list=[me], room_metadata with a roomIdPrefix + base32(16 random octets) room ID, 16-octet random group ID) and calls Room/create, fetches others' KeyPackages with KeyMaterial/fetch, and reads Chat/get + Message/query/get. Room/update, Room/send (.12.6, .12.7) are needed for invite and send over JMAP. Then a live script against mimid.reviewcommit.com with a Haven user.
notes:
2026-11-15 slice 1 done: JMAP transport, /host via Room/create, publish/invite/send over JMAP; tried locally (alice hosts, sends, invites bob). Next slice: receive over JMAP (poll Message/changes or EventSource; Messages are base64url FanoutMessages: Welcome -> join, Commit/Proposal/application -> process). Token/account via mimid admin (no seed change needed).
2026-11-15 slice 2 done: receiving over JMAP (Message/get then Message/changes; own messages skipped by persisted digests; unknown-group messages held by group id). Tried locally with three users. Remaining: the live run on mimid.reviewcommit.com with a Haven user, which needs this mimid deployed there (Mark's OK).
2026-11-15 07:13Z live run on mimid.reviewcommit.com (deployed 07:12, rollback /usr/local/bin/mimid.pre-jmap, chat-dist/mimid-chat.pre-jmap): JMAP KeyPackage/set, Room/create and KeyMaterial/fetch through mimid's hub to Haven's live hub all work (200). jmapalice got noConsent from Haven (erin has not consented to that requester: correct). alice (consented) got success and erin's KeyPackage, but the Add could not be built: 'a leaf does not support required component 0x0023'. Room/create rule 5 needs room_metadata, so the room lists 0x0023 in app_components, and erin's Haven KeyPackages list 0x0021, 0x0022, 0x0025, 0x0027 but not 0x0023. Needs Jason to add 0x0023 to erin's KeyPackages (or a spec question: should a room require every leaf to support room_metadata?). Haven claimed one erin KeyPackage, unused.
